45466.subject: Physics
45466.question_text: The diagram given illustrates a wave form. Determine the speed of the wave
45466.explanation:
The diagram illustrates three complete cycles over a distance of 9 m. Therefore, the wavelength λ is 9 m / 3 = 3 m.

The time t = 0.6 s corresponds to two periods (based on the labeling in the diagram spanning two cycles). Therefore, the period T is \(\frac{0.6 s }{2}\) = 0.3 s.

The speed of the wave v is given by v = \(\frac{λ }{\text{T}}\) = \(\frac{3 m }{0.3 s}\)  = 10 m/s.

45468.subject: Physics
45468.question_text: An object is placed 15cm from a diverging lens of focal length 12cm. The image of the object formed by the lens in
45468.explanation:
The focal length of a diverging lens is negative.

f = -12 cm; u = 15 cm.

\(f = \frac{uv}{u + v}\)

\(-12 = \frac{15v}{15 + v}\)

\(-12 (15 + v) = 15v \implies -180 - 12v = 15v\)

\(-180 = 15v + 12v \implies -180 = 27v\)

\(v = \frac{-180}{27} = -6.67 cm\)

The image is virtual and 6.67 cm from the lens.

45995.question_text: Two angles of a pentagon are in the ratio 2:3. The others are 60<sup>o</sup> each. Calculate the smaller of the two angles
45995.explanation:
The diagram given simple illustrates that a pentagon contains three \(\Delta\)s.

Two angles which are in the ratio 2:3 will have actual values 2xo, 3xo respectively. Thus 2xo + 3xo + 3 x 60 = 3x sum of angles of \(\Delta\)a

i.e. 5xo + 180o = 3 x 180o

5xo + 180o = 540o

5xo = 540o - 180o

5xo = 360o

xo = \(\frac{360^o}{5}\)

= 72o

Hence, the smaller of the two angles is

2 x 72o = 144o
